en: An old Russian Empire-era postal card with preprinted Russian text in Cyrillic at the top reading 'ПОЧТОВАЯ КАРТОЧКА' (postal card). On the left is the imperial double-headed eagle emblem. The card is filled out in cursive handwriting, also in Cyrillic, with several black circular postal cancellation marks and a purple postage or official stamp on the upper right. The bottom has a printed line of text indicating that only the address is written on this side, along with a line mentioning Kiev.
